Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[First Order Stormtrooper (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -1 to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/december2019errata.pdf#page=1 december2019errata.pdf], page 1 (PDF dated 6 December 2019). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
